scenes.title: The Prisoner
scenes.biggestGap: Ward-stone sat behind the seated mage but she turned her head sideways to see it (G4-001); letter direction wrong (G6-002).

sceneContract.placeAnchor: Second cell: door, chair facing it, ward-stone in the opposite wall behind the chair
sceneContract.materialAnchor: chair, ward-stone, boots planted, lamp light
sceneContract.povAnchor: Sylvanas reads the mage's turn toward the stone as a hound at a rustle; palm remembers moss
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: No Jaina dialogue; silent beat carried by twisting in the chair and Sylvanas on the threshold
sceneContract.exitAnchor: stone humming behind the prisoner's head as Sylvanas stands over the chair; cup set down in the guardroom
